objective: Apply one configurable disk quota and file-count cap to the current Desktop profile-background cache and its legacy directory, retaining readable offline files while migrating them safely.

implementation.sharedBudget: The hashed media-cache-v1/images/member-backgrounds directory and cacheDir/member_profile_backgrounds now share the current IMAGES allocation and a 64-file cap.
implementation.eviction: Owned regular cache files across both directories are evicted by least-recently-used modification time when the byte or file cap is exceeded.
implementation.migration: A valid legacy PNG is copied to the hashed cache, size-verified, and only then deleted from its legacy path.
implementation.readOnlyBehavior: If storage policy disables writes, a valid legacy file remains available by its existing file URI.
implementation.safety: Only recognized hashed files and sanitized legacy PNG names are managed; links, unrelated names, and files outside the allowlisted roots are not accepted.
implementation.cleanupTiming: The combined trim is applied when a profile background is read or saved; no startup-wide sweep is introduced.
scopeLimits: This is Desktop-only; no Android APK was changed or built.
No physical PC interaction or sustained performance measurement was performed.
The MSI is a local validation artifact and was not published.
